hypotheses.D4_common_local_operator_is_behaviorally: The frozen mean local operator retains at least 0.80 after the exact downstream map on every corpus.
hypotheses.D5_factorized_local_program_is_behaviora: The exact-read 64-mode inner-rank-8 local program retains at least 0.90 after the downstream map on every corpus.
hypotheses.D6_inner_rank8_preserves_the_causal_atla: The inner-rank-8 local program is within 0.05 of the full-inner-rank 64-mode program on every corpus after downstream composition.
